investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell command creates an HKCU Run registry entry to launch 'powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -WindowStyle Hidden -File C:\ProgramData\winupd.ps1', which establishes persistence. It was executed by user r.kuznetsov on SRV-WEB-02 (Windows Server 2019) and uses bypass/hidden flags and a ProgramData script location that are commonly used to evade detection. No parent process lineage or historical context was provided, and because a non-service user on a server created a persistent startup entry with evasive flags, this activity is assessed as High Priority.
